notes.title: Thank you, Gamescom 2025! 💙
notes.content:
Gamescom 2025 was an unforgettable week for us. ✨


We had the chance to meet publishers, creators, devs, and so many passionate people from the gaming world. Every conversation gave us new energy and ideas to keep building Realm of Fame stronger than ever.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45654016/28c5bce53e41130ec9bbd6c5a857a85d8b63aeb6.png"]

To everyone who shared their thoughts, support, and time with us in Cologne, thank you! 🙌

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45654016/e52395db31be4caeab3e1f1ebf52781eca667e3e.png"]

You can keep supporting us by adding Realm of Fame to your Steam Wishlist:

Wish List Now

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45654016/7bdd779755645921a6b96494951457cdf026abab.png"]

This is only the beginning. Let’s make something legendary together. 💫

notes.title: Realm of Fame Featured on Rock Paper Shotgun! 🎮🔥
notes.content:
Huge thanks to Rock Paper Shotgun for the feature! 🙏🎮
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45654016/68ca8f7b1f7d96156d5de71b5e15a968091b3840.png"]

They described Realm of Fame as:

“A roguelike wrestling adventure in a cursed Byzantine citadel” 

In the game, you can:

Pull off insane moves like falcon dives and bubble suspensions, leaving chaos in your wake

Face corrupted legends and restless demons in epic showdowns

Fight through shifting arenas, storm-battered temples, haunted valleys, and challenge broken champions

We’re flattered, slightly scared, but mostly pumped to see players jump into the ring! 

📖 Read the full article here:

🔗 Zangief basically gets his own game in Hades-style wrestling roguelike Realm Of Fame



🛒 Wishlist Realm of Fame on Steam and join the chaos!

Thanks again to Rock Paper Shotgun and all our amazing supporters!

notes.title: Realm of Fame is Now on Steam
notes.content:
The bell has rung – Realm of Fame has entered the Steam arena!
This isn’t your typical wrestling match. It’s a roguelike rumble packed with bizarre moves, unpredictable twists, and endless ways to win (or lose) in style.

[img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3310030/13f61b483ab10f2cbd8232edbd514e7d6368d19f/ss_13f61b483ab10f2cbd8232edbd514e7d6368d19f.600x338.jpg?t=1754909171"]

Every run brings new challenges, every slam changes the fight, and every match is your chance to claim your place in the realm of legends.

[img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3310030/89a57c5dd722e489798570c3b83a1656c72cd705/ss_89a57c5dd722e489798570c3b83a1656c72cd705.600x338.jpg?t=1754909171"]

✅ Wishlist now so you’re ready for the first bell.

💬 Got a crazy wrestling move idea? Drop it in the Community Hub – we might just try it.



🛒 Visit Realm of Fame on Steam
